messages.subject: server-side does not show...
parts:
Dear shiny-community, 

my problem is as follows: 
I installed shiny-server and deployed a few apps, which run well locally on the server-machine. But when I try to access the apps from another client machine through ethernet, I can see only the left side (ui.R) and not the server.R on the right... 

Thank you very much for your help!

Best regards!

parts:
Yinchong,

Please provide the following information:

On the client machine:
- What operating system are you running (Windows, Mac, Linux)?
- What browser type and version are you using?
- Have you tried with other browsers on your client machine?
- Do you see any errors in the developers tool of your browser?

On the server machine:
- What version of Shiny Server are you running? (Command to run:  shiny-server --version)
- What operation system?
- What version of R?
- What version of Shiny package? (Command to run:  sudo su - -c "R -e \"packageVersion(’shiny’)\"" )

Thanks,
Fereshteh

messages.author: 3da48b33a2f506a9
messages.subject: Re: server-side does not show...
parts:
Hi Yinchong,

It is very difficult to even guess what is going on without any errors in the logs, or any other hints. So I just have to give you some suggestions:

1- About your last comment (server-side panel disappeared on the server-machine): Was this up and running for a while? What caused it to disappear? Did it start working after refreshing the page? Is it possible that it just timed out?

2- I strongly suggest that you install the latest version of Shiny Server. The link to binary and documentation are here:

http://www.rstudio.com/shiny/server/install-opensource

You will get the benefit of all the recent improvements, and it would be easier for us to help you with your issues.
Let us know if for any reason this is not possible for you.

3- If you decide to install the latest version, please pay attention that the default location of log directory, and site directory of applications has changed. Follow the instructions here to upgrade your Shiny Server, and to get started:

http://rstudio.github.io/shiny-server/latest/#upgrading-from-shiny-server-0.3.x
http://rstudio.github.io/shiny-server/latest/#quick-start

4- Assuming you will be installing the latest version:
++ See if that changes the behavior of your applications
++ Check the server log in /var/log/shiny-server.log
++ Check in /var/log/shiny-server directory for an application specific log file. When your application terminates due to an error, there should be some information in this log file.

5- Is there any way that we could get access to your server/application? (you can send me private email if this is possible)

Hopefully we can figure out and resolve your issue.

Best,
Fereshteh
